data.revised_prompt:
Create a clean HD 2D game FX sprite sheet, exactly 2 rows by 2 columns, four animation frames total. Use the provided guide image ONLY for cell placement, spacing, and centering; do not draw any guide lines, borders, labels, or safe-area marks in the final image. Keep a solid #FF00FF background everywhere outside the FX. Each frame must be centered, consistent scale, and contained within the central 65 percent of its cell, with nothing crossing cell edges.

Theme: a bomb effect that looks like the surface of a playing card being ripped apart by a flash. Effect only; no full card, no UI, no text, no icons.

Frame 1 (top-left): thin white cracks appear around the center, subtle golden-white glow beginning underneath.
Frame 2 (top-right): strong golden-white flash splits into jagged paper-rip shards, dramatic burst from center, bright edges.
Frame 3 (bottom-left): small bright paper-like fragments and sparks fly outward, energetic debris, still centered and contained.
Frame 4 (bottom-right): fading shards, smoke-free golden dust, lingering crack glow, softer and dimmer than prior frames.

Style: stylized card-game VFX, crisp readable silhouettes, high contrast, sharp jagged torn-paper shapes, gold and white lighting, no smoke, no flames, no additional objects. Keep everything neatly contained inside each cell and avoid touching the cell boundaries. Transparent-looking FX is not needed; background must remain solid #FF00FF outside the effect.
